audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart shows a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer (matching the packet) says Vex owns levels 1 through 6, Malzahar spikes at first item, and late is a skill fight.
audit.why: Her 1200-range Mistral Bolt and Gloom-empowered poke beat Malzahar's step-up pattern until his first item; his sustained damage plus point-click R then equalizes.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content win[] with whys rewritten per row.

audit.why: Spikes: her poke dominance 3-5, her edge at 6 (Shadow Surge escape + fear-cancel threat), his first-item flip, even late — spikes[0..3] already state these accurately.

audit.whatIsWrong: 18 misgendered fields (Vex is she/her), no digit in breakdown.cooldowns, two copy-paste-bleed bullets, and the fear is attributed loosely — Vex's fear comes from Doom 'n Gloom (P) empowering her next basic ability, not from Personal Space (W) intrinsically.
audit.why: W Personal Space is 16s rank 1 / 12s max (shield + burst); her R is 140/120/100 vs Malzahar's 140/110/80. Critical nuance: Malzahar's passive grants CC immunity while up, so her fear only cancels his R channel after the shield is broken — bait the fear or shield the fear, then channel.
audit.corrected: All pronoun fixes folded in, cooldown numbers added, bleed bullets replaced with fear/silence sequencing.
